svg.title: What surface motion holds and what turns
svg.desc: Two matched zoning-free Oceanic Mollweide panels show cross-season directional agreement and maximum seasonal turning derived from four seasonal OSCAR means. Cross-season agreement and turning are OSW diagnostics derived from one historical year. They are not natural boundaries, Lagrangian coherent structures, full-depth flow, or heat transport.
svg.metadata: Source data SHA-256: 94716c1dcf21188c1dad651562ae4c57297bc63bae82a929e9b00b42956e4ea0. Source artifact SHA-256: bb1aa2d76de6bc6438114561f8d2401b2c88f24c5b00a521bbf324d354c9ec15. Cross-season alignment: magnitude of the mean of four seasonal unit-direction vectors; 0 cancels, 1 aligns. Maximum turn: largest pairwise angle between four seasonal mean-velocity directions; degrees from 0 to 180. Natural Earth commit ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19, SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9. Rendered arrows: 722; turning points: 759. No OSW zones are drawn.
